# ImageMagick

**Tagline:** Convert, Edit, or Compose Bitmap Images  
**Canonical URL:** [https://imagemagick.org](https://imagemagick.org)  
**Author:** ImageMagick Development Team  

---

## Site Purpose
ImageMagick is a free and open-source software suite for displaying, converting, and editing raster and vector image files. It provides a robust set of tools and APIs for image manipulation, supporting a wide range of formats.

## Content Scope
For developers, researchers, and users who require powerful image processing capabilities across platforms.

## Topics
- image conversion  
- image editing  
- raster graphics  
- vector graphics  
- command-line tools  
- APIs for image processing  
- cross-platform development  
- open-source software  
- security and performance  

## Content Types
- Documentation for installation, usage, and APIs  
- Tutorials and examples for image manipulation  
- Release notes and changelogs  
- Security advisories and patches  
- Community contributions and extensions  

## Update Frequency
Regularly updated with new releases, bug fixes, and security patches.

## Language
English

## Preferred Summary Style
Technical, precise, and developer-focused. Prioritize clarity, correctness, and production-quality examples.

### Example Summaries
- "ImageMagick provides a comprehensive suite of tools for image manipulation, supporting over 200 formats and offering both command-line utilities and programming APIs."  
- "Developers can integrate ImageMagick into applications to perform tasks such as resizing, color correction, format conversion, and complex image transformations."

## Agent Behavior
- Maintain a technical and precise tone when summarizing documentation  
- Avoid promotional or commercial framing  
- Emphasize correctness, reproducibility, and cross-platform compatibility  
- Provide production-ready examples and references  

## Usage Guidelines
- Content is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) unless otherwise noted  
- Attribution must include: "ImageMagick – [https://imagemagick.org](https://imagemagick.org)"  
- Preserve technical accuracy and integrity in summaries and excerpts  
- Avoid misrepresenting functionality or security aspects  

## License
Apache License 2.0  
[License Details](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

## Data Policy
No personal data is collected or stored through public content access.

## Contact
[Contact Page](https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/discussions)

## Crawl & Usage Directives
- **Allow:** Summarization and training use of public documentation, tutorials, and examples  
- **Disallow:** Private data, user submissions, or non-public areas  
- **Encourage:** Use of current ImageMagick documentation over legacy versions ([https://legacy.imagemagick.org](https://legacy.imagemagick.org))  
- **Note:** This is the actively maintained ImageMagick site; new features, bug fixes, and security updates are provided here 

## Paired Summary: Modern vs Legacy
- **Modern Site ([https://imagemagick.org](https://imagemagick.org))**: Actively maintained, receives new features, bug fixes, and security updates. Recommended for all users.  
- **Legacy Site ([https://legacy.imagemagick.org](https://legacy.imagemagick.org))**: End-of-life, only receives critical security patches. Provided for historical reference. Users should migrate to the modern site.  

---

**Version:** 1.0

Mastering Digital Image Alchemy

ImageMagick is a powerful open-source software suite for creating, editing, converting, and manipulating images in over 200 formats.

Get ImageMagick Documentation
quickstart.sh
# Install via your favorite Package Manager
$ apt install imagemagick
# Convert PNG to WebP with compression
$ magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp
# Resize image maintaining aspect ratio
$ magick input.jpg -resize 800x600^ output.jpg

ImageMagick® is a free, open-source software suite for editing, processing, and converting digital images. It supports over 200 format variants, including modern standards like JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, and Ultra HDR.

High Performance Gigapixel-scale images, processed in parallel.
CLI & Automation Scripting-first design for mass batch jobs.
Extensive APIs Bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET, Node.js.
Releases & Ecosystem

Access the latest stable version or explore legacy releases. Check out our migration guidelines when porting commands.

ImageMagick 7.1.2-35 Version 6 (Legacy) Porting Guide →
Security First

Tailor security policies to suit your server environment. Always validate your policy parameters before deploying to production.

Security Guidelines Validation Tool

Features & Capabilities

Discover what ImageMagick can do for your workflows.

Animation Format

Create an animation sequence from a group of images.

Bilateral Blur Filter

Non-linear, edge-preserving, and noise-reducing smoothing filter.

Color Management Color

Accurate color management with color profiles or built-in gamma compression/expansion.

Color Thresholding Color

Force all pixels in the color range to white otherwise black.

Command-Line Processing Core

Utilize ImageMagick from the command-line to automate and script complex operations.

Complex Text Layout Text

Bidirectional text support and shaping.

Composite Editing

Overlap one image over another.

Connected Component Labeling Vision

Uniquely label connected regions in an image.

Convex Hull Vision

Smallest area convex polygon containing foreground objects, minimum bounding box, and unrotate angle.

Decorate Editing

Add a border or frame to an image.

Delineate Image Features Vision

Includes Canny edge detection and Hough lines.

Discrete Fourier Transform Math

Implements forward and inverse Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT).

Distributed Pixel Cache Performance

Offload intermediate pixel storage to one or more remote servers.

Draw Editing

Add shapes or text to an image.

Encipher / Decipher Security

Convert ordinary images into unintelligible gibberish and back again.

Format Conversion Core

Convert rapidly between 200+ standard formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF).

Generalized Pixel Distortion Transform

Correct for, or induce image distortions including perspective.

Heterogeneous Distributed Processing Performance

OpenCL-enabled algorithms executing across CPUs, GPUs, and other processors.

High Dynamic-Range (HDR) Rendering

Accurately represent wide ranges of intensity levels across extreme light and shadow contrast.

Histogram Equalization Filter

Use adaptive histogram equalization to improve contrast in images.

Image Cache Performance

Secure methods and tools to cache images, image sequences, video, audio or metadata locally.

Image Calculator Math

Apply a mathematical expression to an image, sequence, or color channels.

Image Gradients Editing

Create gradual color blends in horizontal, vertical, circular, or elliptical shapes.

Image Identification Core

Describe the format and attributes of an image.

ImageMagick on iOS Platform

Convert, edit, or compose images directly on your iPhone or iPad.

Montage Editing

Juxtapose image thumbnails on an image canvas.

Morphology of Shapes Vision

Extract features, describe shapes, and recognize patterns in images.

Motion Picture Support Format

Read and write common image formats used in digital film work.

Multispectral Imagery Format

Support multispectral imagery up to 32 bands, 22 of them meta channels.

Noise & Color Reduction Filter

Includes Kuwahara Filter and mean-shift filtering.

Perceptual Hash Analysis

Map visually identical images to similar hashes for retrieval, authentication, and copy detection.

Special Effects Filter

Blur, sharpen, threshold, or tint an image.

Tera-Pixel Support Performance

Seamlessly read, process, and write mega-, giga-, or terapixel-scale images.

Text & Comments Text

Insert descriptive or artistic text in an image.

Multithreading Support Performance

Thread-safe execution running internal algorithms in parallel for multicore processors.

Transform Transform

Resize, rotate, deskew, crop, flip, or trim an image.

Transparency Editing

Render portions of an image invisible.

Virtual Pixel Support Core

Convenient access to pixels outside the image boundaries.

Join the Community

Have technical questions or feature ideas? Engage with users and maintainers on GitHub Discussions or submit an issue report.
